summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its Proxy Notice and Statement for the 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The meeting is scheduled for June 29, 2026, in Valencia, Spain, with remote attendance permitted. The agenda includes standard shareholder items; no extraordinary transactions are proposed. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report. Category assigned as Other because, while not a traditional special situation, the proxy statement may involve management changes or other non-routine items. No deal terms applicable. What to watch: any voting outcomes and potential director elections.
